markets.rules_primary: If neither team scores the first touchdown in the Arizona vs San Francisco Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 27, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on the team that scores the first touchdown in the Arizona vs San Francisco Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 27, 2026. All touchdowns count for this market, including offensive, defensive, and special teams. If the first touchdown of the game is recorded in overtime, then the market for that team still resolves to Yes. If neither team scores a touchdown in the full game (including overtime), then the market titled "No team scores a TD" resolves to Yes.

If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
